llm_response.reason: The site's content mimics a major legitimate e-commerce platform (Lazada), uses aggressive large discounts, encourages installing external apps, promotes multiple unrelated domains (via all main buttons/links), and features a domain name ('wb2btalkradio.com') unrelated to shopping. Links to t.ly shorteners and a sushi restaurant as a bonus resource, combined with copied branding and poor business practice indicators, fit many core scam signals—especially site mimicry, non-existent business legitimacy, unusual payment/onboarding flows, and inappropriate external links.
